venue.name: MidAmerican Energy Company RecPlex
venue.address: 6500 Grand Avenue, West Des Moines, Iowa 50266

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM4NTAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--41ac44901c7b50477a8e52aee36bc01c95bf26af/Heartland%20Champs%202026%20Logo.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczVkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0464d9393ec8beda5bced7e4e963ea197166594d/image.png)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) as the Heartland Regional Championship of 2026.

Competitors from Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion.

items.name: 3x3 in Madison 2026
items.information:
Welcome to the finale of our four-year long Madison events series and Wisconsin's first 3-day competition since 2019. Enjoy every official 3x3 event and more! If you're new to competing, this is a great competition to be your first. 

This competition is supported by the Midwest Cubing Association.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA0MzczLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0b2bff7fdab6f00f6ece00325e15fc57dd4e5896/MCA-Final-Logo%20(Vector%20png).avif)

items.name: Nordic & Swedish Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIzNjU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5235948e002bc4f499657630eeb0b8e823b34f9/NM_long.png)

Welcome to the Nordic & Swedish Championship 2026!

We are very excited to welcome you all to IFU Arena in Uppsala - the venue which will host the World Championship 2027.

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

-----

Välkomna till det Nordiska & Svenska Mästerskapet 2026! 

Vi är mycket glada över att välkomna er alla till IFU Arena i Uppsala – arenan som kommer att stå värd för VM 2027.

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.
